note: VEFL adds a Views exposed form style 'vefl_basic' (Basic (with layout)) that lays exposed widgets into Layout API regions. Config lives in a view's display_options.exposed_form: type=vefl_basic and options.layout = {layout_id (default vefl_onecol, region 'middle'), widget_region: {<widget_id>: <region_id>}}. Widget ids = filter identifiers + actions (sort_by, sort_order, items_per_page, offset, submit, reset). Ships one layout vefl_onecol. Service vefl.layout. No permissions/drush/plugin-managers. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real view config: setup/reset write a views.view.* config object (via the config API, which sidesteps an unrelated pre-existing site issue where content-entity field mapping for commerce_giftcard blocks full entity saves), the agent inspects or edits the exposed_form layout, and verify reads it back.

evals.prompt: I want my Views exposed filters arranged into layout regions instead of one row. Which Views exposed form style does the vefl module add, and what is its plugin id?
evals.expected_output: VEFL adds the exposed form style 'Basic (with layout)', plugin id vefl_basic (the vefl_bef submodule adds 'Better Exposed Filters (with layout)', id vefl_bef). Choose it in the view's Exposed form settings, then assign each widget to a layout region.

evals.prompt: Which layout does the vefl module ship out of the box, and what other layouts can I use for a Views exposed form with vefl?
evals.expected_output: VEFL ships one layout, vefl_onecol (a single 'middle' region, declared in vefl.layouts.yml). Any layout registered via core layout_discovery works too - core layouts, Display Suite, and Panels layouts - because the list comes from the core layout plugin manager.

evals.prompt: With the vefl module, how does a themer override the markup of a view's exposed form, and which theme hook does vefl use?
evals.expected_output: VEFL renders through the vefl_views_exposed_form theme hook but uses standard Views suggestions, so you override with views-exposed-form.html.twig or views-exposed-form--VIEWNAME(.--DISPLAY).html.twig in your theme; widgets are already grouped into layout regions by template_preprocess_vefl_views_exposed_form.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a view named 'vefl_known' whose exposed form is laid out with vefl. Inspect the live view configuration and state which layout region the exposed 'title' filter widget is assigned to.
evals.expected_output: In views.view.vefl_known the exposed_form (type vefl_basic) has options.layout.widget_region.title = 'middle', so the title widget renders in the 'middle' region of the vefl_onecol layout.

evals.prompt: Inspect the view named 'vefl_known2' on this site and state which exposed form style (plugin) and which layout its exposed form uses.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vefl_known2 uses exposed_form type vefl_basic ('Basic (with layout)') with options.layout.layout_id = vefl_onecol.

evals.prompt: The view 'vefl_task' on this site currently uses the plain 'Basic' Views exposed form. Using the vefl module, change its exposed form to the layout-aware style using the vefl_onecol layout, and apply the change to the live site.

The view 'vefl_region' already uses vefl's layout exposed form (vefl_basic + vefl_onecol) but its exposed 'title' filter is not placed in any region. Assign the 'title' widget to the 'middle' region and apply the change to the live site.
